scheme_name: Term Loan Scheme- Credit Line 1 for Minority Community
other_conditions: Annual family income not exceeding ₹98,000 in rural areas or ₹1,20,000 in urban areas
Belongs to a minority community (Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis, Jains)
Must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID)
benefits_summary: Loans up to ₹20,00,000 at a concessional interest rate for minority community members to enhance employability.
